description: Seventh blind context-search probe, frozen before first execution. Its raw baseline was 17/40 top-1, 32/40 top-10, and 0.5574 MRR. One module-ambiguous UTC normalizer case was adjudicated to accept all behaviorally matching implementations, producing a corrected baseline of 18/40 top-1, 33/40 top-10, and 0.5812 MRR. Forty previously unused primary targets are split evenly across conversational Russian, mixed RU/EN, adjacent-role disambiguation, behavior-to-test, and Wiki-intent cohorts. Promotion requires at least 95% top-1, 100% top-10, and 0.97 MRR without target-specific identity boosts.
